messages.text: Registration received for Mugisha Brian (P2). Application is currently under review by School Administrator Norbert Ihimbazwe Manzi.
Muraho Administrator Norbert, we submitted Brian's transfer report from his previous school. Please let us know if additional documents are needed.
Muraho Alice! We have verified Brian's transfer report and report card. His academic profile looks strong for P2. Confirmation and student ID badge will be issued shortly.
Murakoze cyane Administrator Norbert! Will Brian also be enrolled in the school hot lunch program?
Yes, absolutely! Hot lunch and afternoon school bus route to Mugina center are both included in his enrollment package.
Registration received for Keza Divine (Nursery Top Class). Assigned reference code MHA-2026-5120.
Good morning Admin Norbert, does the school bus pick up children near the Mugina commercial trading center?
Good morning Jean Damascene! Yes, Bus Route #1 stops at Mugina Commercial Center every morning at 6:45 AM with our dedicated teacher chaperone.
Application CONFIRMED & ENROLLED. Student ID: MHA-STU-2026-088. Welcome to Mugina Hope Academy!
Application received for Uwase Ange (P4). Reference: MHA-2026-3409.
Mwiriwe Norbert, we uploaded Ange's birth certificate and previous school report card. Please confirm when orientation starts.
Mwiriwe Marie Claire, documents received in pristine condition. Orientation for new Primary learners begins on the first Monday of the term at 8:00 AM.
Registration received for Irakoze Prince (Primary 1). Application assigned ref code MHA-2026-9214.
Muraho Administrator Norbert! We applied for Prince to join Primary 1. We also requested school van transport and hot lunch.
Muraho Emmanuel! Prince's enrollment file for P1 is confirmed in order. Van transport from Mugina center and daily nutrition meal plan have both been reserved.
Murakoze cyane Norbert! Does the school issue official uniforms on opening day?
Yes Emmanuel, two sets of tailored navy & gold uniforms and sports kit will be handed to you upon arrival at the registrar desk.
Application received for Uwera Clarisse (Nursery Baby Class). Reference: MHA-2026-6330.
Good afternoon Administrator Norbert, Clarisse is 3 years old. Are the Nursery Baby care rooms equipped with sleeping cots and dedicated matrons?
Good afternoon Solange! Yes, our Nursery Baby hall features child-safe padded flooring, individual sanitized cots for midday naps, and trained full-time childcare matrons.
That gives us great peace of mind! Thank you Norbert, we look forward to the visit.
